## What I Build

- **Landing pages** — Figma to Framer, 3-day delivery
- **Multi-page marketing sites** — 4-page bundle in 5 days, larger scopes available with CMS, blog, lead capture
- **Webflow / WordPress migrations** with full SEO redirect map
- **Chrome extensions** — Manifest V3 in React + TypeScript, single-popup or SaaS-integrated with OAuth + webhooks
- **Monthly retainers** — ongoing copy, design, and build for SaaS marketing teams
- **UX copywriting** — included in every project (not a bolt-on); written from a kickoff interview, competitor study, and positioning pass
